signature.name: VTask.cast
signature.type: {α : Type u_1} -> {n m : ℕ} -> (h : n = m) -> Sym α n ≃ Sym α m

conventions.statement: When h is rfl, VTask.cast h s = s for all s.
conventions.note: The cast is the identity when the equality proof is reflexivity.

conventions.statement: The simp normal form pushes VTask.cast outward in expressions.
conventions.note: Simp lemmas are oriented to move casts toward the outermost position.
